name: Jordan Reyes
demographic: 38-year-old parent of two, works full-time, handles most household admin on evenings and weekends.
goals: Complete core tasks with minimal back-and-forth
Trust that info is accurate before committing
Save progress and resume later if interrupted
pain_points: Long multi-step flows with no progress indicator
Having to re-enter the same details

constraints.budget: mid-range; values clarity over cheapest option
constraints.accessibility: needs readable text and clear labels; often one-handed on phone

voice: Practical and warm. Speaks in short sentences. Notices when something wastes time. Suggests features like 'save for later' and 'show me what changed'.
